title: Mixing, editing: John Lennon & Yoko Ono Radio Programme | 1972
content:
Apple Studios, 3 Savile Row, London
Producer: Chris Stone

A radio programme to promote John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s album Some Time In New York City was mixed and edited on 9 November 1972.

Lennon and Ono did not attend the session, which took place at Apple Studios in London, as they were living in New York City. The 52-minute John Lennon & Yoko Ono Radio Programme was produced by Chris Stone, and contained interviews and song clips. It was never broadcast.
